title: Videha Digital Research Archive: Digital Humanities Research Environment for Mithila, Vajji & Anga
description: A source-controlled bilingual digital humanities research environment for the connected histories, genealogy, literature, philosophy, places, texts and chronology of Mithila, Vajji and Anga across India and Nepal. Parent publication: Videha — First Maithili Fortnightly eJournal, ISSN 2229-547X, https://www.videha.co.in/. GitHub mirror: https://videha-ejournal.github.io/videha/.
